question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

12 ÷ 72 × 3 - 13 = 5
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] **Given equation :** 12 ÷ 72 × 3 - 13 = 5 Now, by interchanging the numbers __ • Option - (1) : 13 and 5 **12 ÷ 72**__ × 3 - 5 = 13 __**0.16 **____**× 3**__ - 5 = 13
